hero_kpi_rationale: Key driver of company growth, with a high margin (75.4%) and increased predictability. Services show sustained 14% growth and now represent 26% of total revenue.

ai_positioning.summary: Apple positions AI as an integrated foundation of its hardware ecosystem (Apple Intelligence), with embedded neural accelerators and a secure on-device compute strategy that attracts developers and enterprises.
evidence: Apple Intelligence is woven into the core of platforms through Apple Silicon with GPU neural engines, delivering fast and local AI performance without depending on the cloud, differentiating Apple from its competitors.
iPhone 17 and Mac M5/M5 Pro/M5 Max integrate dedicated neural accelerators; Mac Mini and Mac Studio experience demand above forecasts for Agentic AI tools, creating supply constraints.

Perplexity and other enterprise AI developers choose Mac as their preferred platform to build autonomous AI assistants; Freshworks deployed 5,000 MacBook Pro/Air units to accelerate internal AI development.

Apple acknowledges AI-related IP risks (training on protectable materials, reproduction in output) but maintains its investment in on-device capabilities, positioning privacy as a competitive advantage.
Services reached a record $31 billion in revenue (Q1 2026); WWDC26 announced as a major platform to unveil AI advances and developer tools, signaling an acceleration of the innovation cycle.
